svg.desc: bcachefs key derivation in Excalidraw style. Userspace (bcachefs-tools) reads the passphrase, runs scrypt with superblock parameters and checks the resulting key, then hands it to the kernel. The kernel unwraps the master key from the superblock, checks the magic, keeps it in bch_fs.chacha20_key and encrypts each extent with ChaCha20, storing a Poly1305 MAC as the checksum. Each step names the responsible source file and function.
